status: Exploratory plan written after primary-source and demographic screening, before computing any panel outcomes. Not independently preregistered.
question: Do unchanged gingival panel age directions transfer to separately deposited, participant-coded healthy bulk gingiva when donor age, sex and processing batch are observable?
reference_eligibility: Usable for a bounded source-labelled-healthy, donor-coded bulk-expression age challenge; not a sex-balanced population reference or independent adjudication of clinical health.
matrix_policy: Read exact unique gene symbols and nonnegative integer counts, verify every AC column against one official GSM participant code, sum all features for library size. No outcome-based gene filtering, duplicate-symbol picking or differential-expression feature selection.
normalization: CPM from each library's total supplied counts, then log1p, then unweighted mean over exactly mapped frozen panel genes. No cross-cohort scaling, age clock, batch correction using evaluation outcomes, training or retraining.
primary_reason: 10 healthy women span 28-75 years and both batches; only two healthy men (32/39) are available. This prespecified restriction is based on metadata, not expression outcomes.
model_policy: OLS with intercept and centered age/10; add male and/or batch B indicator only as named. Preserve rank failures; require at least two residual degrees of freedom. Disease and gingivitis samples never enter healthy age fitting.
diagnostics: Retain individual omission effects, coefficient ranges, rank, residual degrees of freedom and leverage; these ranges are not confidence intervals.
comparison_policy: Compare signs with earlier bulk GSE83382 and the specified GSE164241 cell compartment, without pooling scores, people or effect magnitudes. Mixed bulk and cell-resolved expression are different estimands. Missing genes and age ranges remain visible.
limits: GEO labels are source metadata; sampling/extraction indication, oral exposures and detailed health ascertainment are not recovered here.
Participant codes are one library each in the official patient-based series design. They are not externally verified person identifiers or proof that all historical study participants differ.
Two healthy men cannot identify a male age trajectory, and no older healthy man occurs in batch B.
Bulk cell mixture, gene length effects, normalization, cohort and batch may change directions; sign agreement does not establish cell-intrinsic aging.
A source-labelled healthy transcript association is not an intervention, a measure of lost function, rejuvenation or a repair target.
